definition_en: to think that something is true, or to have faith in someone

senses.title: To accept as true

senses.why: This is the core sense: the mind says yes to a claim.

senses.title: To think or suppose

senses.why: In everyday speech belief softens into a polite opinion.
senses.whyCN: 在日常口语里，「相信」弱化为一种客气的看法。

senses.title: To have faith in

senses.exampleCN: 她相信善意的力量。

senses.title: A ringing metal object
senses.definition: a hollow metal object that rings when struck

definition_en: a strip worn around the waist, or a long narrow area
core_image: 工人系紧皮带走进车间
scene: 他系紧皮带，把工具包挂上去。He tightened his belt before climbing.
sceneCN: 这里 belt 是「腰带」（第 1 个义项：系在腰上的带状物）；句意是他爬之前系紧了腰带。

pos.zh: 动词：用带子系住；（口语）猛击

derivatives.zh: 由 belt 加 -ed 构成，义为「系腰带的」
由 belt 加 -ing 构成，义为「传动带材料」
由 belt 与 way 复合，义为「环城公路」

senses.title: A strip around the waist
senses.definition: a strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist
senses.definitionCN: 系在腰上的皮革或布带
senses.example: He tightened his belt before climbing.
senses.exampleCN: 他爬之前系紧了腰带。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, borrowed from Latin for a strap.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，借自拉丁语中表示带子的词。

senses.title: A long narrow area
senses.definition: a long region with a special feature
senses.definitionCN: 具有某种特征的长条区域
senses.example: This city sits in the industrial belt.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市位于工业地带。
senses.why: A belt wraps around, so a wide band of land took the name.
senses.whyCN: 腰带是环绕的，因此一大片带状土地也得此名。

senses.title: A moving strip in a machine
senses.definition: a continuous strip that carries things
senses.definitionCN: 连续运转、用来运送物品的带子
senses.example: The boxes moved along the belt.
senses.exampleCN: 箱子沿着传送带移动。
senses.why: The shape of a waist belt matches the loop inside machines.
senses.whyCN: 腰带的形状与机器里的环形带一致。

intro.en: Belt came into Old English from Latin balteus, a strap.
intro.cn: belt 经拉丁语 balteus（带子）进入古英语。

items.en: balteus meant a girdle or strap.
items.cn: balteus 意为「腰带、带子」。

items.en: belt named a waist strap.
items.cn: belt 指腰间的带子。

items.en: belts held tools and swords.
items.cn: 腰带用来挂工具和剑。

items.en: machines gained moving belts.
items.cn: 机器开始使用运转的带子。

items.en: belt also names long regions of land.
items.cn: 如今 belt 也指狭长的地带。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one letter; the near-meaning group gives strap and zone words.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个字母；近义组是带子与区域的词。

normal.en: The plural is belts.

normal.en: A seat belt keeps you safe in a car.

normal.en: An industrial belt is a factory region.

abstract.en: See a worker pulling a leather belt tight.

dict_mnemonic.text: belt 读起来短而紧，正像一条勒紧的腰带。

root: 借自拉丁语 balteus（腰带），古英语作 belt，本指腰间带子，十九世纪起用于机器传动带，并引申指带状地域。

sensesIntro.en: The same strip wraps a waist, a machine and a stretch of land.

definition_en: a long seat, or a strong table used for work
core_image: 公园里被晒暖的木长椅
scene: 午后，一位老人坐在公园的长椅上。An old man sat on a park bench.
sceneCN: 这里 bench 是「长椅」（第 1 个义项：供多人坐的长条座椅）；句意是一位老人坐在公园的长椅上。

pos.zh: 名词：长椅；工作台；法官席
动词：（体育）把球员换下场

derivatives.zh: 由 work 与 bench 复合，义为「工作台」
由 bench 与 warmer 复合，义为「替补队员」

senses.title: A long seat
senses.definition: a long seat for two or more people
senses.definitionCN: 可供两人以上坐的长条座椅
senses.example: An old man sat on a park bench.
senses.exampleCN: 一位老人坐在公园的长椅上。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, a plain seat made of wood or stone.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，指木制或石制的简易长座。

senses.title: A strong work table
senses.definition: a sturdy table for a craftsman or worker
senses.definitionCN: 工匠或工人使用的坚固台面
senses.example: The tools are laid out on the work bench.
senses.exampleCN: 工具摆在工作台上。
senses.why: A long seat and a long table share the same flat shape.
senses.whyCN: 长条座椅与长条桌面共用同一种扁平形状。

senses.title: The seat of a judge
senses.definition: the seat or office of a judge
senses.example: The lawyer approached the judge's bench.
senses.exampleCN: 律师走向法官席。

abstract.en: See a wooden seat warmed by the sun.

definition_en: to make something curved, or a curve in a road
core_image: 柳枝被风压弯又弹回
scene: 风把河边的柳枝压了下去。The wind bent the willow branches.
sceneCN: 这里 bend 是「使弯曲」（第 1 个义项：把直的东西压成弧形）；句意是风把柳枝吹弯了。

derivatives.zh: 由 bend 加 -er 构成，义为「弯曲者、狂欢」
由 bend 加 -y 构成，义为「易弯曲的」
由 un- 加 bend 构成，义为「弄直、放松」
由 bend 的过去分词转成的形容词，义为「弯的」

senses.title: To make something curved
senses.definition: to force something straight into a curve
senses.example: The wind bent the willow branches.
senses.exampleCN: 风把柳枝吹弯了。
senses.why: This is the core sense, and it works for metal, wood and limbs.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心义，适用于金属、木头和肢体。

senses.title: A curve in a road
senses.definition: a place where a road turns
senses.example: Slow down before the bend.
senses.exampleCN: 拐弯前要减速。
senses.why: The verb became a noun, naming the curved part itself.
senses.whyCN: 动词转作名词，用来指弯曲的那一段。

senses.title: To give in
senses.definition: to yield to pressure or rules
senses.example: He refused to bend to their demands.
senses.exampleCN: 他拒绝向他们的要求屈服。
senses.why: Something that bends under force gives up its straight shape.
senses.whyCN: 在力量下弯曲的东西，放弃了原本笔直的形状。

definition_en: in or to a lower position than something, or below the level of
